title: Mochi Mode
description: A mod that adds an easy-low consequence mode that can be enabled per player. Not everyone enjoys difficulty.
body:
# Have you found yourself in this situation?

*   You want to play Minecraft with someone.
*   They don't want to play because it's too stressful.
*   The consequences of dying in the game are too harsh for them.
*   They just want a relaxed experience without having to worry too much.
*   They don't like to constantly remake tools because it is tedious.

If so, I have the solution for you, introducing:

# The Mochi Mode Mod

This mod does the following:

*   Only players with Mochi Mode enabled will have these abilities that will help them play Minecraft.
*   Allows admins to enable Mochi Mode for multiple players, so everyone can have fun playing Minecraft, even the newbies.
*   Upon taking damage that would have killed them, instead of dying, they get teleported to their bed or spawn. Upon teleportation, they are given speed and absorption for two minutes.
*   Items now have infinite durability for them. As the durability reaches 0, they will get a replenished tool with full durability. (We are not responsible for any apocalypse scenarios with this mechanic interacting with other mods.)
*   And much more to come in the future.

# How to use?

*   To give a player mochi status, do `/mochimode toggle_mochi_status [player]`
*   To see a player's mochi status, do `/mochimode get_mochi_status [player]`
*   If you are a mochi, you can activate and deactivate your powers at will using `/mochimode activate` and `/mochimode deactivate`

_Note: I made this mod for my Girlfriend, so it's features only pertain to her wants and needs._
